558.headline: Chris extends the heater to five
558.recap: Five straight winning games for Chris, which ties his all-time record. Tim got a warm welcome: $6 straight into Chris's pocket.

lines.Chris: +$6.10 and a five-game win streak. At this point he's not playing poker, he's collecting rent.
lines.John: +$1.35. The all-time leader showed up, took a toll, and left. Classic.
lines.Andy: +$1.15! Andy finished in the green. Screenshot it, frame it, this might not happen again till spring.
lines.Andrew: −$2.60 in his own house. Hosted the game, supplied the table, and paid the cover charge too.
lines.Tim: Welcome to the table, Tim. That'll be $6, paid directly to Chris. Every newcomer's first lesson.

559.headline: Chris makes it six. Andy pays for everyone.
559.recap: Chris squeezed out +$0.60, just enough for six straight winning games, a new personal record. Andy went from the green in Game 1 to covering the whole table's winnings.

lines.Tim: +$3.95. Paid his $6 in Game 1, came back and took most of it off Andy. The newcomer is learning fast.
lines.Andrew: +$3.30. The host finally charged admission. Took long enough.
lines.Chris: +$0.60. Six in a row, a new record. Barely won, but a streak is a streak.
lines.John: −$0.05. Lost a nickel. Somehow that's the most embarrassing result on the board.
lines.Andy: −$7.80. Every dollar anyone else won this game came straight out of Andy's stack. So much for the Game 1 comeback.
